fields.name: line_no
fields.title: Line number
fields.description: Position of the line in the recipe's ingredient list. Numbers can skip where a fragment that was not an ingredient was removed.

fields.name: raw_line
fields.title: Ingredient line as written
fields.description: The ingredient line as it appears in the source, e.g. '1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)'.

fields.name: qty
fields.title: Quantity as written
fields.description: Quantity text: '1', '3/4', '1-1/2'. Blank when the line states none ('salt to taste').

fields.name: unit
fields.title: Unit as written
fields.description: Unit named in the line, normalised to one spelling. Blank when the line names none.

fields.name: unit_key
fields.title: Unit used for conversion
fields.description: The unit looked up in unit_conversions: the parsed unit, else '(count)' or '(none)'.

fields.name: grams
fields.title: Weight (g)
fields.description: Estimated weight of the line in grams: qty_num x the gram value in unit_conversions, or that value alone when there is no quantity. Blank for six 'water as required' lines.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.title: Ingredient name as written
fields.description: Ingredient name with quantity, unit and preparation removed. Joins to synonyms.name_raw.

fields.name: state
fields.title: Preparation
fields.description: Preparation or form as written ('grated', 'finely chopped'). Free text.

fields.name: dry_fresh
fields.title: Dry / fresh
fields.description: Whether the line specifies a dry or fresh form.

fields.name: parse_status
fields.title: Parse status
fields.description: How the line's quantity, unit and name were decided.

fields.name: ingredient_id
fields.title: Ingredient ID
fields.description: The canonical ingredient this line names; see ingredients.
